rationale: Price is at 86.8% of today's range after a 14.7% gap-up on strong earnings, with the last five 1-minute candles showing a clear deceleration and rollover from the $84.31 high — volume is drying up (10K→11K→2K→2K→4K) and price is drifting lower, suggesting the initial gap momentum is exhausted. A long risks chasing near the high with a wide 76.8 bps spread eating into any edge, while a short into a strong fundamental catalyst with elevated relative volume (5.98x) and a rising broad market (SPY +0.67%, VIXY -4.41%) carries meaningful squeeze risk. The risk/reward in either direction is insufficiently asymmetric to justify adding exposure.
